class="mb-[40px]"><h1 class="text-[36px] font-[600] leading-[1.3] text-brand-1 mb-[16px]">The H3 Family: Models, Community, and What&#x27;s Next</h1><div class="flex items-center gap-[16px] text-[14px] text-[#86909C]"><time>2026-11-26</time></div><div class="flex gap-[8px] mt-[16px] flex-wrap"><span class="px-[10px] py-[4px] text-[12px] bg-[#F4F4F4] text-zinc-700 rounded-[6px]">H3 Family</span></div></header><div class="prose max-w-none text-[16px] leading-[1.8] text-brand-1"><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Openness is what turns a technology into an ecosystem. A handful of gifted people can invent a technology or build a tool. Only when people share what they&#x27;ve built and work together as a network can creativity flourish and change the way we live.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">AI ecosystems start with open source. <strong>In the 100 days since we open-sourced MiniMax H3, developers have turned one H3 into 1,472 derivative models for 1,472 distinct needs and uses. Together, these models have been downloaded more than 148 million times, an average of over 17 downloads a second.</strong> New derivatives continue to appear.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">H3 has given enthusiasts, developers, and companies a common starting point. Leading technology companies such as NVIDIA, Tencent, and Alibaba have trained their own versions of H3 for different purposes. So have AI application and platform leaders including fal, Suno, HeyGen, Pika, and Creatify, and research teams at MIT, the National University of Singapore, and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. More than ten leading companies worldwide now have licensing partnerships with MiniMax. <!-- -->They&#x27;re <!-- -->using H3 to strengthen production workflows in e-commerce, gaming, film and TV, animation and comics, short-form dramas, industrial design, and other fields.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Today we&#x27;re introducing the H3 Family, which includes the flagship H3 and H3-Image series and a range of extended models. The flagship models and some of the extended models are available directly through the MiniMax Open Platform, MiniMax Code, and other platforms.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">We&#x27;ll keep open-sourcing our work and supporting developers as they create with the H3 series. Together, we want to build one of the defining communities for multimodal creation in the AI era. Thank you to every user and developer for your trust, your ideas, and the work you&#x27;ve put in.</p><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6">Flagship models</h2><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed"><strong>More power, more speed, and more variety</strong></p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">MiniMax H3</h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Image quality comes first for high-end commercial productions</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">2K or 768P output, starting at <!-- -->$0.08 per second</p><div class="html-block"><video controls width="2560" height="1440" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:2560/1440;margin:12px auto;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-01-1795536000000-1795533544734.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">You can tell H3 what you wish a scene would feel like, even when the idea is still hazy. It understands minimalist chic in an ad, a sense of mystery and fate in a film, or a traditional Chinese aesthetic in animation. It picks up on the difference between a character who is angry, one who feels wronged, and one who can&#x27;t accept how things turned out. It can carry the story forward in a way that fits the characters and render it at up to 2K.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">H3 also follows instructions closely through a series of precise edits. You can replace a person, an item of clothing, or an object, or change the light and shadow in one part of a shot. The rest of the frame stays intact as you continue to refine it.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">MiniMax H3-Highspeed</h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">A first choice for everyday commercial work and large-scale production</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">768P or 480P output, starting at <!-- -->$0.04 per second</p><div class="html-block"><video controls width="1344" height="768" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1344/768;margin:12px auto;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-02-1795536000000-1795533544834.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">H3-Highspeed balances speed and cost with the quality and reliability that daily production demands. A five-second clip takes about 11 seconds to generate on average. For clips up to 15 seconds long, it takes no more than a minute to go from prompt to finished video. The model supports clips up to 30 seconds long.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">We worked with our partners to bring down inference costs. Teams in e-commerce, gaming, motion graphics, and live-action advertising often need a steady supply of material in large volumes. H3-Highspeed produces it in batches at a lower cost while maintaining quality. It&#x27;s like having a colleague you can count on in your day-to-day work.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">MiniMax H3-Lite</h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">A lower-cost way to try out ideas</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">768P or 480P output, starting at <!-- -->$0.025 per second</p><div class="html-block"><video controls width="1344" height="768" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1344/768;margin:12px auto;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-03-1795536000000-1795533538353.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">On some hardware, H3-Lite generates a five-second 768P clip in about eight seconds. Video output for that clip costs about $0.20, with lower rates for high-volume use.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">H3-Lite&#x27;s speed and low cost make it easier to work efficiently. Early in a project, you can test several ideas, compare the results, and choose a direction while spending less time and money. It&#x27;s also well suited to producing repetitive commercial material in volume, such as dozens of ads showing the same product in different settings, or different characters acting out similar storylines.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">MiniMax H3-Image</h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Fast generation, high image quality and close adherence to instructions</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Image output costs <!-- -->$3.80 per million tokens</p><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-04-1795536000000-1795533542661.gif" alt="MiniMax H3-Image example" width="1079" height="607" style="display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:12px auto;border-radius:12px" /></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">H3-Image produces high-quality images with rich detail and a realistic look. It follows instructions more closely than any other open-source model and supports up to 16 reference images. It also offers good value, generating images at 150% to 200% of the speed of mainstream models for 50% to 70% of the price.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">MiniMax H3-Image Highspeed</h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">4K images in 10 seconds</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Image output costs <!-- -->$7.60 per million tokens</p><div class="html-block"><div style="display:flex;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;align-items:flex-start;margin:12px 0"><img style="flex:0 0 auto;width:auto;max-width:85%;max-height:620px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px" /></div></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">At its fastest, H3-Image in Highspeed mode can generate a 4K image in under 10 seconds. It runs 3 to 4 times as fast as mainstream models in the same tier, making 4K practical for everyday work.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:16px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6">Extended models</h2><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed"><strong>Options for specialized needs</strong></p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">fal: H3 Max</h3><div class="html-block"><video controls width="1344" height="768" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1344/768;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-11-1795536000000-1795533554928.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: fal’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">H3 Max generates a five-second 768P clip in under three seconds. Following prompts was a particular focus during training, so the model is both fast and responsive to what you ask for.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">fal: H3-Max Turbo</h3><div class="html-block"><video controls width="1344" height="768" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1344/768;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-12-1795536000000-1795533553263.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: fal’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">H3-Max Turbo generates video twice as fast as H3 Max. That opens up real-time interactions, virtual try-ons, continuous livestreams, and deduction games. There may be more you can do with it than we&#x27;ve thought of yet.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">MachGen: MiniMax H3</h3><div class="html-block"><video controls width="1344" height="768" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1344/768;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-13-1795536000000-1795533551313.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: MachGen’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">With MachGen&#x27;s hosted model, you can preview results faster and use your own LoRAs to control the visual style.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">Nunchux AI: MiniMax-H3-Fast (Radical Speed)</h3><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-14-1795536000000-1795533557931.gif" alt="Nunchux AI: MiniMax-H3-Fast (Radical Speed) example" width="588" height="336" style="display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px" /><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: Nunchux AI’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Nunchux AI optimized the model with hardware partners. It generates a 15-second 768P clip in about 6.5 seconds, making it well suited to creative work that takes several attempts and revisions.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">RunningHub: MiniMax H3 RH</h3><div class="html-block"><video controls width="1286" height="716" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1286/716;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-15-1795536000000-1795533570858.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: RunningHub’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">MiniMax H3 RH is well suited to short-form dramas, animated comic series, and e-commerce. Its strength is continuity. Even in a long, complex, unbroken shot, it keeps the character, setting, and story consistent.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">HeyGen: Video 1</h3><div class="html-block"><video controls width="2160" height="3840" style="display:block;width:min(100%, 420px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:2160/3840;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-16-1795536000000-1795533607259.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: HeyGen’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">AI avatars are HeyGen&#x27;s largest business, so the team places particular emphasis on applications such as e-commerce. Video 1 can generate a complete video up to 30 seconds long in one pass, including visuals, dialogue, and sound effects.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">Utopai Studios: Utopai X</h3><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-17-1795536000000-1795533569390.gif" alt="Utopai Studios: Utopai X example" width="640" height="360" style="display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px" /><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: Utopai Studios’ official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">The team at Utopai Studios developed Utopai X inside a film studio specifically for filmmakers, with a focus on lighting and motion that obey the laws of physics.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">Suno: H3 Move</h3><div class="html-block"><video controls width="720" height="1260" style="display:block;width:min(100%, 420px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:720/1260;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-18-1795536000000-1795533584896.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: Suno’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Suno, a leading global AI music platform, developed H3 Move specifically for music videos. Working from a song&#x27;s style and lyrics, it can produce a performance with lip movements matched precisely to the song, or a music video with an elegant, offbeat, ethereal, or modern look.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">Creatify: Boreal-H3</h3><div class="html-block"><video controls width="714" height="1280" style="display:block;width:min(100%, 420px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:714/1280;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-19-1795536000000-1795533573849.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: Creatify’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Creatify trained Boreal-H3 specifically for e-commerce ads. It pays particular attention to the product on screen, what it looks like in use, and the on-camera model&#x27;s appearance and accent.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">Pika: H3 Flex</h3><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-20-1795536000000-1795533581456.gif" alt="Pika: H3 Flex example" width="480" height="274" style="display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px" /><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: Pika’s official website</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Pika H3 Flex generates video in six steps and gives creators fine control over camera movement, action, and sound effects. It&#x27;s well suited to people making ads or short films.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">LightX2V / ModelTC: MiniMax-H3 Turbo</h3><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-21-1795536000000-1795533588917.gif" alt="LightX2V / ModelTC: MiniMax-H3 Turbo example" width="640" height="366" style="display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px" /><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: LightX2V / ModelTC’s official model page</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">MiniMax-H3 Turbo reduces video generation to four or eight steps and can run locally. It&#x27;s designed for professionals who have their own deployment environment and want shorter waits.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:10px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5">Akatz Labs: Character Swap V1.5</h3><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/h3-family-22-1795536000000-1795533596097.gif" alt="Akatz Labs: Character Swap V1.5 example" width="960" height="400" style="display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:12px" /><p style="text-align:center;color:#626b76;font-size:0.875em;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;margin:4px 0 12px">Source: Akatz Labs’ official model page</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Akatz Labs built on H3 to improve its ability to replace just one part of a shot. Character Swap is designed primarily for one task. Choose the person to replace, and the reference character performs the original person&#x27;s movements and expressions while the rest of the scene stays the same.</p><div class="html-block"><div style="height:16px;margin:0;padding:0;line-height:0"></div></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">These third-party and community models each have their own strengths and excel at particular tasks.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">All are available through the MiniMax Open Platform API. The H3 Family page features more examples of what people have built with H3.</p><div class="html-block"><p style="margin:0">Explore the H3 Family at <a href="https://www.minimax.io/h3-family" style="display:inline;white-space:normal;word-break:break-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#2563eb;text-decoration:underline">https://www.minimax.io/h3-family</a></p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">See MiniMax Open Platform pricing at <a href="https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview#h3-series-extended-models" class="text-blue-600 underline hover:text-blue-800">https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview#h3-series-extended-models</a></p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">As one H3 grew into the H3 Family, we saw how a new technology can co-evolve with its users and their creations. The H3 Family has grown out of those experiences and the feedback people have shared.</p><div class="html-block"><p style="margin:0">We'll continue to welcome H3-based derivative models into the H3 Family. The partnership is open to developers and companies around the world. If you have a new idea for video generation in AI avatars, film and TV, e-commerce, gaming, or another field, we invite you to build a custom model on H3. To become a partner, fill out the application form at <a href="https://platform.minimax.cn/console/contact" style="display:inline;white-space:normal;word-break:break-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#2563eb;text-decoration:underline">https://platform.minimax.cn/console/contact</a>. You can also take part in the H3 community by sharing your ideas and needs in our discussion groups or through other channels.</p></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">We&#x27;ll keep open-sourcing models and improving our tools so that individuals can express their ideas more easily, teams and industries can solve real business problems more efficiently, and more people can benefit as the open-source community around multimodal AI grows.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">On the 25th anniversary of the World Wide Web, its inventor, Dr. Tim Berners-Lee, summed up his hope for its future in the words “What you create is limited only by your imagination.”</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">We look forward to building tools for creation together with our users. We hope technology, openness, and imagination will take us into a wider world and, ultimately, to AGI.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Intelligence with Everyone.</p></div></article><footer
